messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Service and Subscription Management" as it appears in the following examples.
['ITUNES STORE FAMILY MEMBERSHIP 1 YEAR | 05/09 2018', 'BT is improving your email service and action is needed by you to ensure that you continue to receive email.', 'This is your official notification that the service(s) listed below will be deactivated and deleted if your profile is not verified immediately.', 'Your Account will expire shortly, if you would like to continue using your email Address, Click here To Re-activate.', 'In order for AOL Online access to continue uninterrupted, please update your billing information today.', 'You are advised to upgrade your account and cancel the request now', 'Tap below to get a more organized mailbox to avoid being deactivated.', 'As the Primary Contact, you must renew the service(s) listed below, or it will be deactivated and deleted.', 'If this sign up was made by someone else, and you want to cancel the subscription, click the link under the sign-up information in this letter, and then change the password on your profile, perhaps it was stolen.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

message.content: {"summary":"Maintain uninterrupted email and online services by verifying accounts, updating billing details, renewing or upgrading subscriptions, and managing cancellations promptly."}
